subject: INE08XP07274
description: Two versions of Axis Trustee's June 2026 quarter report differ in the action column: the version as on 14 August says the trustee is seeking instructions, and the version as on 16 September reports a waiver at a meeting that day. Only a reader who kept both can see when the position changed.

subject: axis-trustee
description: Axis Trustee's list of issuers from which it says it has received no information has 27 names in its June 2026 quarter reports and 26 in its report as of 29 October 2026; Incredible Realcon Private Limited is no longer printed. The report does not say why.

subject: aye-finance
description: The issuer's own filing prints CIN U65921DL1993PLC283660, while CDSL's page prints U65921DL1993PTC283660. The difference is consistent with conversion from a private to a public company, and trustee reports still use the private-company name.

subject: ctl-t5-2026-06
description: The report's note says the date of actual breach is taken as the quarter for which the covenant certificate was submitted, and eight of its printed serial numbers print the quarter-end, 30 June 2026. The other six print a later date equal to the detection date. Intervals computed from this column therefore do not all mean the same thing.

subject: INE179P08082
description: Three public statements of one covenant differ. The issuer's annexure for 31 December 2025 prints <=70%. The trustee's June 2026 quarter report quotes "less than 80%" from the Effective Date until the Final Settlement Date. The trustee's notice for the same quarter quotes "less than or equal to 80%" until September 30, 2026, and cites an Amendment Deed dated 29 July 2026. The deed itself has not been retrieved.

subject: INE179P07530
description: In Catalyst Trusteeship's file of notices, the second notice dated 27 August 2026 prints INE179P07464, the same ISIN as the first, while the follow-up letter and agenda that continue it print INE179P07530. No notice in the file introduces INE179P07530 by name, though the trustee's report lists it.

subject: INE179P07589
description: The issuer's annexure for 31 December 2025 says all covenants were complied with except those listed, and does not list this ISIN. It prints a return on assets of -1.02% against another ISIN. IDBI Trusteeship's June 2026 report prints, for this ISIN, return on assets maintained of -1.02% against a requirement of 1% or more. The documents do not say whether this covenant was tested at December 2025 or how each computes the ratio.

subject: INE139F07105
description: IDBI Trusteeship's June 2026 report names only the debt service coverage ratio for this ISIN, while its notice to holders of 14 August 2026 says the meeting is about a breach in "Debt Service Coverage Ratio and Debt Equity Ratio".

subject: INE362A07054
description: IDBI Trusteeship's June 2026 report names only non-execution of a pledge agreement, while its press release of 16 June 2026 also cites non-submission of the corporate guarantor's audited financial statement. The press release concerns the March 2026 quarter according to its accompanying notice, and the report row carries a June 2026 date.

subject: samunnati-finance-2014
description: Catalyst Trusteeship's report prints one row for "Samunnati Finance Private Limited" covering INE551U ISINs and INE0N5S07052. The CDSL pages for those ISINs show the same name with different CINs (U65990TN2014PTC096252 and U65990TN2021PTC146392), and the ISINs carry different issuer codes. The dataset keeps two issuer records until the relationship between the two entities is established from a primary source.

subject: INE187O07031
description: Vistra ITCL lists this ISIN in its breach report, while the CDSL corporate bond database page prints Bank of Maharashtra under Debenture Trustee Details.

subject: INE501X07588
description: Catalyst Trusteeship lists this ISIN in its own breach report and sends notices to its holders as trustee, while the CDSL corporate bond database page prints Central Bank of India under Debenture Trustee Details, beside a due date of 30-Dec-1999 that looks like a placeholder.

subject: INE07J407014
description: For this ISIN the further-action cell cites emails of 30 January and 28 March 2024, before the printed breach dates of 20 July and 20 October 2024. For INE187O07031 the printed intimation date, 6 June 2025, precedes the printed detection date, 17 June 2025. All dates are recorded as printed.

subject: vistra-t5-2026-06
description: The file draws much of its text as vector outlines, so text extraction returns rows 2 and 4 in part and rows 1 and 3 not at all, and no header. Read from text alone the report seems to lack a header, a first row and an issuer name; the rendered page has all of them. Anything built on extracted text alone would misread or miss this trustee's disclosures.
